name: Deadly Quiet, Communal
body:
School illusion; Level bard 2, cleric/oracle 2, inquisitor 2, sorcerer/wizard 2

EFFECT

Range creatures touched

DESCRIPTION

This spell functions as deadly quiet, except you divide the duration among the creatures touched.
